arStrings.szText: When {c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} explodes, it spawns {c_number}3{/c} smaller spirits that seek enemies and explode for {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_VARIANT_A}{/c} damage each.

{c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} becomes a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill that deals Shadow damage.

{c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} leaves behind a pool of {c_important}{u}Desecrated Ground{/c}{/u} when it explodes, dealing {c_number}{dot:TOOLTIP_DOT}{/c} Corrupting damage.
{c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} no longer seeks enemies and instead spirals around you, piercing through enemies and exploding for {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_VARIANT_C}{/c} damage when it hits them.
{c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} gains {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} additional Charge and its Charge Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}{SF_18}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} becomes a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill, costs {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} Essence, and no longer has a Cooldown.

{c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} will consume all of your remaining Essence on cast, dealing {c_number}[{SF_13}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage for each point of Essence consumed.
Every second, your next {c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_39}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage, up to {c_number}[{SF_39}*{SF_40}*100|x%|]{/c}.
Each enemy hit by {c_important}Bone Spirit{/c} increases your Maximum Essence by {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} seconds, up to {c_number}{SF_30}{/c} Essence.
